Данные в реальном времени или с задержко: Is the data real-time or delayed?
Цены акций и фьючерсов показываются на з: Stock and futures prices are shown as of the close: the price of the day is the last trade before 19:00 Moscow time, and it appears on the site after 19:10. This is a requirement for redistributing exchange data and applies to all plans, including paid ones. Open interest is not covered by this restriction and is shown up to date; on the free plan it is delayed by one day. MOEX and RTS indices update once a day after the close, and Capital flows (CBR) update monthly after the Risk Review is published.

У вас есть мобильное приложение?: Do you have a mobile app?
Сайт работает как Progressive Web App (P: The site works as a Progressive Web App (PWA) — you can “install” it as an app straight from the browser (Safari/Chrome → “Add to Home Screen”). You get an icon, fullscreen and pull-to-refresh without installing from the App Store / Google Play. All indicators are optimized for mobile screens.
Простые определения ключевых терминов ан: Plain definitions of key terms for analyzing the Moscow Exchange. Each term comes with a short explanation and a link to the matching Frame indicator.
Открытый интерес — это количество открыт: Open interest is the number of open positions in futures and options on the Moscow Exchange: how many contracts derivatives market participants currently hold and on which side. Rising open interest means new money flowing into the instrument; falling means positions are being closed.
Тепловая карта рынка — это карта акций М: The market heatmap is a map of Moscow Exchange stocks on one screen: tile size reflects the company's market cap and color shows the return over a day, week or month. The MOEX market map lets you see in seconds which sectors and stocks are rising or falling.
Индикатор Баффета (индекс Баффета) — отн: The Buffett indicator (Buffett index) is the ratio of total stock market capitalization to the country's GDP. High values signal an overheated market, low values an undervalued one. Named after Warren Buffett, who considered it one of the best measures of market valuation.
Сила рынка показывает, какая доля акций: Market breadth shows what share of stocks trade above their moving averages. It is a leading indicator: broad participation confirms a healthy trend, while narrowing breadth warns of a possible reversal before it shows in the IMOEX index.
Сезонность — закономерность, при которой: Seasonality is a pattern where stock returns depend on the month or time of year over many years of history. Seasonal statistics help spot historically strong and weak months (for example, the “sell in May” rule or the year-end rally).
Поток капитала — нетто-операции участник: Capital flows are the net operations of market participants: who buys and sells on the Russian market (non-residents, retail, banks, funds) in stocks, bonds and FX. The source is the Bank of Russia's monthly Financial Market Risk Review.
БПИФ — биржевой паевой инвестиционный фо: A BPIF is an exchange-traded mutual fund traded on the Moscow Exchange like a regular stock (the Russian equivalent of an ETF). The fund holds a basket of assets — stocks, bonds, gold or money market instruments — and a unit reflects its value.
Чистые притоки и оттоки капитала в бирже: Net daily inflows and outflows into exchange-traded funds (BPIF and ETF). Fund flows show which asset classes Russian investors are buying and selling right now and where retail money is moving.
Рыночная капитализация — стоимость всех: Market capitalization is the value of all of a company's shares (share price × number of shares). The sum of company capitalizations gives the capitalization of the whole market, used for example in the Buffett indicator and when building the heatmap.
Срочный рынок (FORTS) Московской биржи —: The Moscow Exchange derivatives market (FORTS) is the venue for trading derivatives: futures and options. A future is an obligation to buy or sell an asset in the future at a pre-agreed price; an option gives that right without the obligation. Open interest is calculated on them.
IMOEX (индекс Московской биржи) — основн: IMOEX (the Moscow Exchange index) is the main benchmark of the Russian stock market, weighted by free-float-adjusted market capitalization. It reflects the overall performance of Russia's largest public companies.
Участники торгов делятся на категории: ф: Market participants are divided into categories: individuals, Russian legal entities, banks, asset managers and non-residents (foreign investors). Splitting positions by category helps understand who moves the market — retail traders or large institutional players.
